name: Family pack
subtitle: Every uniform and every everyday thing.
description: A family pack of 20 fabric labels for uniforms and 20 QR stickers for bottles, lunchboxes, books and bags. Every label carries your child's name and QR.

name: Everyday stickers
subtitle: Small stickers. A big way back.
description: Peel-and-stick QR labels for bottles, lunch boxes, notebooks and smooth everyday surfaces. Each label connects to one private item record.

name: Cable wraps
subtitle: Your cable, even in a crowd.
description: Six wrap-around QR labels for charging cables and leads. The QR sits on a flat flag so it can be scanned without bending the code around a thin cable.

name: Trackable tags
subtitle: Coming soon.
description: A trackable tag for bags, keys and wallets, with a FindBox recovery identity. Coming soon: the hardware, battery and locating features are being confirmed before orders open.
